title: data(wood): shrinkage for 377 species that had none (FPL 126, Wood Database 251)
intent: Owner GO 2026-11-19: fill empty tangential/radial shrinkage in wood_species.json from the Wood Database, each value cited to its own species page with per-field source. Where FPL GTR-282 Tables 4-3/4-4 have the species (126), the FPL value is used per CLAUDE.md priority. Stacked on PR #497.
behavior_change: wood_movement_calc returns results for 377 more species instead of raising ValueError (supported species 57 -> 434). No code, route or schema change; no existing value changed.

diff_articulation.what_changed: wood_species.json: 377 records gain contraction_tangential_pct / contraction_radial_pct with per-field provenance (FPL_GTR282_table_4-3/4-4 + table row for 126; wood_database_meier + page URL for 251; _approximate flag on 13 whose page prints '~'; subspecies caveat on keyaki). VERIFICATION_LOG: C-16 and O-12. Update template: documents the _approximate and _shrinkage_caveat qualifiers. Test: shrinkage-coefficient sanity bound widened to the published range (1.5-15% tangential).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These 377 species had no shrinkage value, so the wood-movement calculator rejected them.

commands_run: json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) reproduces the parent commit's wood_species.json byte-for-byte before editing
seeded random sample of 30 bulk-copy rows vs live wood-database.com pages: 30/30 tangential and radial values match
all 18 whole-number rows re-read from their live pages for the '~' marker: 13 approximate, keyaki subspecies
scripted diff vs parent commit: _meta and all other fields identical; only these 377 records changed, each only by adding shrinkage/provenance keys
wood_movement_calc.list_species() = 434; get_shrinkage_data returns the new values (teak, iroko, abura spot-checked)
py -3.11 -m pytest wood-movement and related suites; scripts/ci/test_policy_fpl_examples.py

files.intent: C-16: owner ruling, method, sample result, exclusions, FPL vs Wood Database comparison on 126 shared species, Tropix-priority deviation for 20 species; O-12 updated.
Sourced tangential/radial shrinkage with per-field attribution for 377 species that had none.
files.behavior_change: wood_movement_calc accepts these 377 species instead of raising ValueError.

files.intent: Widen test_shrinkage_coefficients_realistic from 3-12% to 1.5-15% tangential: published FPL values (Pacific madrone, shellbark hickory, overcup oak, karri) exceed 12%.

risk_rationale: Medium: additive data only, but large (377 records) and taken through a third-party bulk copy verified by a 30-row sample, not page by page. Known limitations: 20 species have a Tropix sheet that CLAUDE.md ranks above the Wood Database; 13 values are approximate at source; duplicate records of one species get identical values; 4 records with species mismatches were excluded rather than resolved.
